summary: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation.
takeaways: We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings.
Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation.
In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning.
